note: Java bridge: GraalVM native-image support. The vespera-bridge JAR now ships reachability metadata under META-INF/native-image/kr.devfive/vespera-bridge/ (jni-config.json for every class/method the Rust side looks up through JNI: InputStream.read/close, OutputStream.write/flush, Consumer.accept, CompletableFuture.complete, the thrown exceptions' (String) constructors and the jni crate's internal bindings; resource-config.json for the bundled native/<platform>/ libraries; reflect-config.json for Thread.isVirtual), and the Spring Boot autoconfiguration registers Spring AOT hints (VesperaBridgeRuntimeHints: proxy handler method, Spring Security authorities). Spring Boot apps build with the org.graalvm.buildtools.native plugin and nothing else. NativeImageMetadataTest keeps the metadata in sync with the JNI lookups in crates/vespera_jni; the demo app builds natively with -PnativeImage, smoke-tested by scripts/native-image-smoke.sh and the manual Native Image workflow.
